title: One-level K-flat model for the normalized scalar tensor mate
statement: Fix l,E,X,D,hl and a tensor presentation a over the completed integral coefficient sheaf B [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. Fix a K-flat complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let T_P be ordinary total tensor with P, q the derived localization, and A_P the functor a.tensor(q(P),-). There exists a natural isomorphism e:T_P;q ~= q;A_P whose component on every K-flat Q equals a.representative(P,Q). For every single level n, every normalized reduction presentation m at n, and every family of chain maps b_Q:T(P,F_n Q) -> F_n T(P,Q) satisfying the pure-section rule x tensor (s tensor y) -> s tensor (x tensor y), the following equation holds for every K-flat Q: A_P(c_n(Q));e(F_n Q)^(-1);q(b_Q) = mate_m(P,Q);U_nF_n(e(Q)^(-1));c_n(T(P,Q)). Here F_n is ordinary extension followed by restriction, c_n the specified derived representative comparison [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], and mate_m is the transpose under the actual scalar adjunction of mu(P,U_nF_n Q);tensor_n(1,counit);mu(P,Q)^(-1) [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. This statement contains no transition between levels and imposes no relation between presentations at different levels.

proof.text: Tensor with the K-flat P preserves quasi-isomorphisms by the signed cone comparison. Descend along localization and extend the tensor representative comparison from K-flat complexes; K-flat resolutions and their localization comparison give e, with its required components and naturality.

For a single level, take a K-flat resolution S of the restricted extension of Q. Naturality identifies e there with its value on S. Untranspose using the scalar adjunction and use ReductionPresentation.normalization on (P,S) and (P,Q). The ordinary scalar counit multiplies coefficients. Its composite on each homogeneous pure tensor is exactly x tensor (s tensor y) to s tensor (x tensor y).

Use the pure-section hypothesis on b, tensor/sheafification/total-summand extensionality, and then localization. The restriction representative comparison is the restriction factor of the derived scalar counit. Cancel the resolution and normalized comparison isomorphisms to obtain the equation. The same e works for all levels because it was constructed solely from a and P.

theorem restrictionTensor_mate_model
    (a : TensorPresentation.{u, u} X (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl))
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
    (hP : flat.{u, u} X (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl) P) :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X
    let F := fun n : ℕ ↦ (sfReductionRestricted l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let T := totalTensor.{u, u} X R
    let A := (Functor.curry.obj a.tensor).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    ∃ e : (T.obj P) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ A,
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
          (hQ : flat.{u, u} X R Q),
        e.hom.app Q = a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : ReductionPresentation l E X D hl a n)
          (b : ∀ Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ,
            (T.obj P).obj ((F n).obj Q) ⟶ (F n).obj ((T.obj P).obj Q)),
        (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
            (i j : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
            (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj U)
            (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X j).val.obj U),
          ((b Q).f (i + j)).val.app U
              (totalPair.{u, u} X R P ((F n).obj Q) i j U x
                (sfReductionTensor l E X n (Q.X j) U s y)) =
            sfReductionTensor l E X n (((T.obj P).obj Q).X (i + j)) U s
              (totalPair.{u, u} X R P Q i j U x y)) →
        ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
            (_hQ : flat.{u, u} X R Q),
          A.map (sfReductionRepresentativeComparison l E X n Q) ≫
              e.inv.app ((F n).obj Q) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (b Q) =
            (derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction.{u, u} l E X n).choose.homEquiv _ _
              (m.mu.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P,
                  (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E X n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
                m.target.tensor.map
                  (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj
                    (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
                    ((derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction.{u, u}
                      l E X n).choose.counit.app
                        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj
                          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)))) ≫
                m.mu.inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
              (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E X n).map (e.inv.app Q) ≫
              sfReductionRepresentativeComparison l E X n ((T.obj P).obj Q)
